title: dk-quickstart-group-index-1.0
description: Schema for a dk0 quickstart group index. The index lists the recipes available within one group. Whoever owns a group publishes this file at <group-url>/index.jsonc so the diskuv.com website can enumerate the group's recipes.

schema_version.description: Version of the dk-quickstart-group-index schema used by this index.

quickstarts.description: List of quickstart recipes available in this group.

name.description: Recipe name (e.g. 'opam'), used as the NAME argument in 'dk0 quickstart GROUP NAME' and matching the stem of the corresponding <name>.quickstart.jsonc file.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what the recipe sets up. Third-party text rendered on diskuv.com, so HTML-significant characters ('<', '>', '&'), BIDI overrides, and invisible/control characters are rejected.
